name: Synthetic mineral medium with D-galacturonate, tryptone and yeast extract (anaerobic) (PMC6978723)
description: Synthetic mineral medium with D-galacturonate, tryptone and yeast extract (anaerobic) — medium reported in PMC6978723, extracted for GrowthDB and mapped to BiGG.

provenance.citation: Medium composition from PMC6978723 (see GrowthDB record).
provenance.notes: Composition mapped to BiGG (mapper + salt dissociation); presence-based bounds; paper_amount retained. Added via GrowthDB curation.
provenance.verification_evidence: Unless stated otherwise, liquid medium contained (g L-1): D-galacturonate 4.3; NH4Cl 1.34; tryptone 0.6; yeast extract 0.4; KH2PO4 0.78; Na2SO4.10H2O 0.130; MgCl2.6H2O 0.120; FeSO4.7H2O 0.0031; CaCl2 0.0006; H3BO4 0.0001; Na2MoO4.2H2O 0.0001; ZnSO4.7H2O 0.0032; CoCl2.H2O 0.0006; CuCl2.2H2O 0.0022; MnCl2.4H2O 0.0025; NiCl2.6H2O 0.0005; EDTA 0.10; vitamin solution (Verduyn et al., 1992) 1 mL L-1. An

Yeast extract.citation: Yeast extract supplies free amino acids, B-vitamins (thiamine, riboflavin, niacin, pantothenate, pyridoxine, folate, biotin, B12), nucleotides and minerals — BD Bionutrient Technical Manual (3rd ed.); Atlas RM, Handbook of Microbiological Media (CRC Press, 4th ed. 2010).

Tryptone.citation: Tryptone = pancreatic (tryptic) digest of casein; amino-acid-rich, tryptophan retained — BD Bionutrient Technical Manual; casein amino-acid profile (FAO/WHO).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components).
